exec metagente check $EXAMPLES/clock.ag
stdout 'No problems found'
exec metagente check $EXAMPLES/read_file.ag
stdout 'No problems found'

stdout 'No problems found'
exec metagente check $EXAMPLES/cycle_a.ag

! stderr 'panic|goroutine|\.go:'

# broken_permission.ag is only broken when it runs: the file tool refuses to
# read outside its folder. It passes `check`; the run test arrives with `run`.
exec metagente check $EXAMPLES/broken_permission.ag
